pins_note: Digests of the dacomp-da/ entries (path, bytes, sha256) in benchmarks/metadata/dacomp-data-files.json and assets-files.json, whose per-file hashes come from the official Hugging Face LFS and GitHub sources.
deviations: Primary protocol judges the final report only; upstream rubric scoring prefers the trajectory (upstream-compatible mode reproduces that and is reported separately).
The rubric user query is the task instruction; the released upstream metadata has no instruction.txt, so the upstream script passes an empty query.
Judge models are configurable; upstream examples use gemini-2.5-flash.
Unparseable judge replies are re-requested a bounded number of times (upstream: up to 10); a comparison still missing after retries fails the unit instead of averaging the remaining references.
Units without an accepted report (failed, timed out, invalid report) score 0 on every metric without a judge call; upstream skips instances without an answer file.
Candidate images are the report's validated relative image links; upstream silently drops links that do not resolve.
